title: DuckStation 0.1-10861: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-10861 on February 18, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-10861 on February 18, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: 1feea431b Achievements: Make GameHashToString() public. 72561b507 FullscreenUI: Add missing error parameter to RasterizeSVG(). f0709ae8f Qt: Use L1 string literal where appropriate. ce83fb8f5 Qt: Hook resume state button up to confirm dialog.
